title: SWYFT CANnect Wiring System V2

Simplify your FRC wiring like never before. SWYFT CANnect V2 lets you run CAN bus + 12V sensor power over standard Ethernet cables — cleaner, faster, and more reliable than ever. Perfect for swerve drivetrains, multi-motor mechanisms, or any subsystem that needs CAN and power.

V2 is completely redesigned: smaller, lighter, fully 0.5" grid compatible, and packed with quality-of-life upgrades teams asked for.

  • 30% smaller & lighter modules — easier to tuck anywhere
  • Standard 10-32 holes on 0.5" grid — mounts directly to FRC structure

  • Fully Compatible with V1: Mix and match V1 and V2 modules for seamless upgrades and expansions

Key Features

  • Run CAN + 12V sensor power over a single Ethernet cable
  • Dual redundant CAN pairs built-in — survive a completely severed cable
  • Lever connectors — tool-free, rock-solid wiring
  • Power & termination status LEDs
  • CAN FD & CAN 2.0 compatible
  • Robust resin 3D-printed housing
  • Fully FRC-legal when used within current limits

Modules

  • SWYFT Direct V2 — Connects to each swerve module or device needing CAN + sensor power

  • Mounting: 10-32 holes on true 0.5" grid
  • Cable: 20" high-quality CAT5e included with every module

Important Notes

Use high-quality 22–24 AWG wire for power injection. Always follow the latest FRC wiring rules — see our documentation for full guidelines.

Upgrade to SWYFT CANnect V2 and make wiring the easiest part of your build.

title: HTD 5mm Pitch Timing Belts
body_html:
Timing Belts are a lighter, more efficient alternative to chain. When installed correctly, Timing Belts require no tensioning. The HTD tooth profile results in a high strength power transmission that is suited for the high demanding loads of FRC Robots.

The HTD Belts have fiberglass tensile cord for superior strength, longevity and resistance to elongation.

The HTD Belts come in a variety of sizes and widths to fit even the strictest design requirements.

All belts are Neoprene Coated Fiberglass Tensile Cord

title: Chain Tools
body_html: Chain tools are essential for adding/removing links from a chain. They feature a pin pusher mechanism that makes chain adjustments a simple task.

title: Chain Master Links (5 Pack)
body_html:
Chain master links are essential components used to connect the ends of a chain, forming a continuous loop.

They offer a convenient way to install, remove, or repair a chain without needing tools, making them ideal for quick fixes or adjustments.
